entries.summary: Small slender mouse, grayish to reddish brown above with white underparts and white feet. The finely haired tail is sharply bicolored, dark above and light below. Large ears with little fur, pointed nose, large black beady eyes, long prominent whiskers, shorter forelimbs than hind limbs.
